```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "92%"
)

fit_label <- params$fit_label
generated_at <- params$generated_at
selected_summary <- params$selected_summary
best_params <- params$best_params
`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || !length(x)) y else x
}
parameter_sections <- params$parameter_sections %||% list(list(name = "Best Parameters", table = best_params))

sections <- Filter(
  function(section) is.list(section) && length(section$figures) > 0L,
  params$sections %||% list()
)

section_slug <- function(name) {
  slug <- tolower(trimws(name %||% "section"))
  slug <- gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "-", slug)
  slug <- gsub("(^-+|-+$)", "", slug)
  if (!nzchar(slug)) slug <- "section"
  slug
}

format_report_value <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0L) return("")
  if (is.numeric(x) || is.integer(x)) {
    return(format(as.numeric(x), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE, digits = 15))
  }
  out <- as.character(x)
  x_trim <- trimws(out)
  numeric_pattern <- "^[-+]?((\\d+\\.?\\d*)|(\\.\\d+))([eE][-+]?\\d+)?$"
  numeric_like <- !is.na(out) & nzchar(x_trim) & grepl(numeric_pattern, x_trim)
  if (any(numeric_like)) {
    num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x_trim[numeric_like]))
    keep <- is.finite(num)
    if (any(keep)) {
      idx <- which(numeric_like)[keep]
      out[idx] <- format(num[keep], scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE, digits = 15)
    }
  }
  out
}

format_report_table <- function(tab) {
  if (is.null(tab) || !is.data.frame(tab) || nrow(tab) == 0L) return(tab)
  out <- as.data.frame(lapply(tab, format_report_value), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  names(out) <- names(tab)
  out
}

render_figure_block <- function(fig, section_index, figure_index) {
  fig_title <- fig$title %||% ""
  if (!nzchar(trimws(fig_title)) && !is.null(fig$pdf_asset_abs) && length(fig$pdf_asset_abs)) {
    fig_title <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fig$pdf_asset_abs[[1]]))
  }
  if (!nzchar(trimws(fig_title))) {
    fig_title <- "Untitled Figure"
  }
  fig_legend <- fig$legend %||% ""
  if (!nzchar(trimws(fig_legend)) && !is.null(fig$pdf_asset_abs) && length(fig$pdf_asset_abs)) {
    fig_legend <- paste0("Figure source: ", basename(fig$pdf_asset_abs[[1]]), ".")
  }
  figure_index_use <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(fig$figure_index %||% figure_index))
  if (!is.finite(figure_index_use) || figure_index_use < 1L) figure_index_use <- figure_index
  figure_label <- sprintf("Figure %d.%d %s", section_index, figure_index_use, fig_title)
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    cat('<article class="report-figure-card">\n')
    embed_kind <- fig$html_embed_kind %||% "img"
    if (identical(embed_kind, "pdf_object")) {
      cat(
        sprintf(
          paste0(
            '<div class="report-figure">',
            '<object data="%s" type="application/pdf" class="report-figure-object">',
            '<div class="report-figure-fallback"><a href="%s">Open PDF figure</a></div>',
            '</object></div>\n\n'
          ),
          fig$html_asset_uri,
          fig$pdf_asset_abs
        )
      )
    } else {
      cat(
        sprintf(
          '<div class="report-figure"><img src="%s" alt="%s" class="report-figure-image"/></div>\n\n',
          fig$html_asset_uri,
          figure_label
        )
      )
    }
    cat(sprintf("<p class=\"report-figure-title\"><strong>%s</strong></p>\n\n", figure_label))
    cat(sprintf("<p class=\"report-figure-legend\">%s</p>\n\n", fig_legend))
    cat("</article>\n\n")
  } else {
    pdf_path <- gsub("\\\\", "/", normalizePath(fig$pdf_asset_abs, mustWork = TRUE))
    cat(
      sprintf(
        "![](<%s>){width=92%%}\n\n",
        pdf_path
      )
    )
    cat(sprintf("**%s**\n\n%s\n\n", figure_label, fig_legend))
  }
}

render_blank_figure_block <- function() {
  cat(
    paste0(
      '<article class="report-figure-card report-figure-card--blank">\n',
      '<div class="report-figure report-figure-blank"></div>\n',
      '</article>\n\n'
    )
  )
}

in_vivo_figure_layout_groups <- function(n_figs) {
  requested <- list(
    list(indices = 1:2, cols = 2L),
    list(indices = 3:5, cols = 3L),
    list(indices = 6:7, cols = 2L),
    list(indices = 8:10, cols = 3L),
    list(indices = c(11L, 14L), cols = 2L),
    list(indices = c(12L, 13L, 15L, 16L, 17L, 18L, 19L, 20L, NA_integer_), cols = 3L)
  )
  groups <- lapply(requested, function(group) {
    idx <- group$indices[is.na(group$indices) | group$indices <= n_figs]
    if (!length(idx)) return(NULL)
    list(indices = idx, cols = group$cols)
  })
  groups <- Filter(Negate(is.null), groups)
  used <- unlist(lapply(groups, function(group) group$indices[!is.na(group$indices)]), use.names = FALSE)
  extra <- setdiff(seq_len(n_figs), used)
  if (length(extra) > 0L) {
    groups <- c(groups, lapply(extra, function(i) list(indices = i, cols = 1L)))
  }
  groups
}

section_figure_layout_groups <- function(section, n_figs) {
  if (identical(section$name %||% "", "In Vivo")) {
    return(in_vivo_figure_layout_groups(n_figs))
  }
  lapply(seq_len(n_figs), function(i) list(indices = i, cols = 1L))
}

render_section <- function(section, section_index) {
  figs <- section$figures
  if (length(figs) == 0) {
    cat("_No figures found for this section._\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    groups <- section_figure_layout_groups(section, length(figs))
    for (group in groups) {
      cols <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(group$cols[[1]]))
      if (!is.finite(cols) || cols < 1L) cols <- 1L
      cat(sprintf('<div class="report-figure-grid report-figure-grid--%d">\n', cols))
      for (i in group$indices) {
        if (is.na(i)) {
          render_blank_figure_block()
        } else {
          render_figure_block(figs[[i]], section_index, i)
        }
      }
      cat("</div>\n\n")
    }
  } else {
    for (i in seq_along(figs)) {
      render_figure_block(figs[[i]], section_index, i)
    }
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

render_sidebar_nav <- function(sections) {
  cat('<ul class="report-nav-list">\n')
  cat('  <li class="report-nav-item"><a class="report-nav-link report-nav-h2 is-active" href="#report-metadata" data-target-id="report-metadata">Report Metadata</a></li>\n')
  cat('  <li class="report-nav-item"><a class="report-nav-link report-nav-h2" href="#fit-summary" data-target-id="fit-summary">1. Fit Summary</a></li>\n')
  cat('  <li class="report-nav-item"><a class="report-nav-link report-nav-h2" href="#best-parameters" data-target-id="best-parameters">2. Parameters</a></li>\n')
  cat('  <li class="report-nav-item"><a class="report-nav-link report-nav-h2" href="#figures" data-target-id="figures">3. Figures</a></li>\n')
  if (length(sections) > 0L) {
    for (i in seq_along(sections)) {
      slug <- section_slug(sections[[i]]$name)
      label <- sprintf("3.%d %s", i, sections[[i]]$name)
      cat(
        sprintf(
          '  <li class="report-nav-item"><a class="report-nav-link report-nav-h3" href="#%s" data-target-id="%s">%s</a></li>\n',
          slug,
          slug,
          label
        )
      )
    }
  }
  cat('</ul>\n')
}

render_parameter_sections <- function(parameter_sections) {
  if (length(parameter_sections) == 0L) {
    cat("_No parameter table available._\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  current_group <- NULL
  for (i in seq_along(parameter_sections)) {
    section <- parameter_sections[[i]]
    group <- as.character(section$group %||% "")
    if (nzchar(group) && !identical(group, current_group)) {
      cat(sprintf("### %s\n\n", group))
      current_group <- group
    }
    name <- section$name %||% paste0("Parameter Table ", i)
    tab <- section$table
    heading <- if (nzchar(group)) "####" else "###"
    cat(sprintf("%s %s\n\n", heading, name))
    if (is.null(tab) || !is.data.frame(tab) || nrow(tab) == 0L) {
      cat("_No rows available._\n\n")
    } else {
      tab <- format_report_table(tab)
      cat(knitr::kable(tab, align = rep("l", ncol(tab))), sep = "\n")
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function getTargetId(heading, index) {
    var section = heading.closest('.section');
    if (section && section.id) {
      return section.id;
    }
    var base = heading.id || ('section-' + index);
    heading.id = base;
    return base;
  }

  function setActiveLink(state, activeId) {
    state.links.forEach(function (link) {
      if (link.dataset.targetId === activeId) {
        link.classList.add('is-active');
      } else {
        link.classList.remove('is-active');
      }
    });
  }

  function syncActiveLink(state) {
    if (!state || !state.headings.length) {
      return;
    }

    var threshold = 140;
    var activeHeading = state.headings[0];

    state.headings.forEach(function (heading) {
      if (heading.getBoundingClientRect().top <= threshold) {
        activeHeading = heading;
      }
    });

    setActiveLink(state, getTargetId(activeHeading, 0));
  }

  function bootSidebar() {
    if (window.__reportSidebarBooted) {
      return;
    }
    window.__reportSidebarBooted = true;

    var nav = document.getElementById('report-sidebar-nav');
    var main = document.getElementById('report-main');
    if (!nav || !main) {
      return;
    }

    var state = {
      headings: Array.prototype.slice.call(main.querySelectorAll('h2, h3')),
      links: Array.prototype.slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.report-nav-link'))
    };

    if (!state.headings.length || !state.links.length) {
      return;
    }

    state.links.forEach(function (link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        var target = document.getElementById(link.dataset.targetId);
        if (!target) {
          return;
        }
        event.preventDefault();
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
        window.setTimeout(function () {
          setActiveLink(state, link.dataset.targetId);
        }, 60);
      });
    });

    var throttled = false;
    function onScroll() {
      if (throttled) {
        return;
      }
      throttled = true;
      window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        syncActiveLink(state);
        throttled = false;
      });
    }

    syncActiveLink(state);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', onScroll);
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bootSidebar);
  window.addEventListener('load', bootSidebar);
})();
</script>
```
